svg.title: SD12 — Flee from Combat or Leave a Conversation (UC04 5b, UC03 step 7; F04, F03; Command, State)

g.text: SD12 — Flee from Combat or Leave a Conversation (UC04 5b, UC03 step 7; F04, F03; Command, State)
proposal = new ActionProposal(FLEE or LEAVE, null, null).
Typed "flee" also arrives through SD02; the CLI's "leave"
calls performAction(), so it never reaches sendDialogue()
SD03 — mode check: allows(FLEE) is true only in CombatMode,
result : ActionResult (COMBAT event "fled" or "failed to flee")
